summary.text: Lorie Ball is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Ball is a teacher and educational policy advocate, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Lorie Ball earned an M.Ed. in emotional and behavioral disabilities from Rivier University.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher and an educational policy advocate.
She has served as the treasurer of the Salem Area Women's Club and has been affiliated with the Greater Salem Rotary Club, the Salem Lions Club, and the Derry-Salem Elks Lodge.
Ballotpedia lists Ball's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2022.
